notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch only (requests + bs4, browser-impersonating User-Agent), no Playwright/Chrome needed. robots.txt on both us.hay.com and www.dwr.com allow User-agent:* (Allow: /) for general fetching; both disallow ClaudeBot with full Disallow:/ (blocks tier c only, not used) plus a few functional paths (account, checkout, api, search, Search-UpdateGrid, cart, login) none of which were requested. IMPORTANT SITE-STRUCTURE FINDING: https://us.hay.com/ now 301-redirects entirely to https://www.dwr.com/brands-hay -- HAY US no longer operates as an independent storefront; it is a brand-filtered catalog inside Design Within Reach (DWR)'s Salesforce Commerce Cloud site. TREE: built from DWR's 'Category' refinement facet (productType) on the brands-hay listing, which is the closest equivalent to a mega-menu for this brand (39 flat productType facets, no further sub-nav levels observed -- confirmed by loading each candidate facet's own canonical redirected URL, e.g. /brands-hay?prefn1=productType&prefv1=X redirects to a clean /brands-hay/constant/<slug> URL with the facet pre-checked). No sitemap.xml existed at us.hay.com (it also redirected to the same brand page). QTY: used the site's own exact facet count shown both as the visible '(N)' badge and the screen-reader text 'Currently Refined by Category: X, N products available' on the redirected canonical URL -- this is the site's authoritative explicit total per storage.md/textile.md preferred-order rule 1. Verified this figure against the small facets (Pillows+Throws=4, Coat Racks+Umbrella Stands=1) by de-duplicating base product IDs in the rendered grid, which matched exactly; larger facets (e.g. Storage Accessories, Outdoor Accessories) showed grid contamination from adjacent recommendation-carousel tiles when scraped naively, so the facet's own declared count was used instead of a raw tile count, per the ban on estimating. EXCLUDED categories and why: Sofas+Sectionals, Dining+Side Chairs, Outdoor Lounge Furniture, Side+End Tables, Bar+Counter Stools, Lounge Chairs+Armchairs, Dining Tables, Outdoor Dining Furniture, Office Chairs, Outdoor Benches, Coffee Tables, Ottomans, Bedside Tables+Nightstands, Benches+Stools, Armoires+Wardrobes, Bar Carts/Cabinets+Trolleys, Daybeds+Sleeper Sofas, Desks, Outdoor Coffee+Side Tables = Furniture (out of scope). Table+Desk Lamps, Pendants+Chandeliers, Sconces+Wall-Mounted Lighting, Floor Lamps, Outdoor Lighting+Lanterns, Lighting Cords+Shades = Lighting (out of scope). Mirrors = Wall Decor/Decorative (out of scope). Patio Umbrellas = neither category. Pet Accessories = pet products, excluded per textile.md#18/storage.md#31. Tabletop+Bar Accessories (42) sampled: overwhelmingly plates/bowls/glassware/cutlery/BBQ tools = Kitchen & Dining, the 1-2 textile items inside (a napkin, a tea towel) have no distinct sub-URL of their own so cannot be extracted without a product-detail link (banned) -- whole category excluded. Decor (12) sampled: candles/candleholders/vases (Decorative Accessories) mixed with a couple of textile/bag items -- no single primary product type, excluded as a whole category; its textile items (cushions/throw) are variants of products already captured under Seat Pads/Cushions/Slipcovers and Pillows+Throws so excluding this facet avoids duplicate rows for the same products. Outdoor Accessories (19) sampled: mix of rugs, furniture covers/cushions, portable lamps, vases, a firepit, a canopy, a hammock -- no single primary type, and its genuine textile items (rugs, covers, cushions) already appear under Rugs/Runners/Mats and Seat Pads/Cushions/Slipcovers -- excluded as a whole category to avoid duplicating the same underlying products under a second URL. Shelves+Bookcases (13, Pier Library/Office units, Woody Shelving, Colour/Perforated Floor Cabinets) = site names it as shelving/bookcase furniture, not Storage -- per storage.md#18/#21 (explicit Furniture-style naming wins), classified as Furniture, excluded. Entryway Accessories (5): mostly cleaning tools (dust pan, brooms, not storage products themselves) plus 2 Facet Storage Cabinet items already captured under Storage Accessories -- excluded as a whole category, no double-count. Coat Racks+Umbrella Stands (1, 'Knit Coat Rack') = not explicitly a storage-named category and not covered by storage.md's rack/organizer list; treated as entryway furniture, excluded. INCLUDED: Seat Pads, Cushions + Slipcovers (48) = outdoor furniture cushions and fabric covers, matches textile.md#4 (cushions) and #12 (Garden/Patio Furniture Covers explicitly listed as Outdoor Textiles) -- Textile HIGH. Rugs, Runners + Mats (5) = genuine rugs (Crayon Rug, Tapis Rug, Peas Rug, Bias Rug, Haze Outdoor Rug) -- Textile HIGH. Pillows + Throws (4) = 2 cushions + 1 throw, verified by name -- Textile HIGH. Storage Accessories (7) = crates, laundry basket, storage cabinet, rack -- genuine storage -- Storage HIGH. Office + File Storage (5, Pier Library units + Pier Office) = explicit 'Storage' naming by the site per storage.md#15/#21 preference for explicit site categorization -- Storage HIGH. No multi-level hierarchy exists on this brand catalog (facets are flat siblings under the single brands-hay root, which itself is not a valid Textile/Storage node since it has valid sub-facets) so no grouping rows were emitted, per the parent-URL rule (rule 25/34) -- all 5 rows are leaves.
